target_customer: Early stage startups and small software companies that lack an in house growth team
problem: Founders do not get round to outbound, ads and search content, so pipeline stays thin while they build product.
business_model: Subscription, Pro from 99 USD per month plus a managed tier with a growth engineer
product_category: AI growth agent for outbound, paid ads and SEO

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating agents across email, LinkedIn, seven ad platforms and content is mostly integration and prompt work with some hard parts in measurement and approvals.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI growth and outbound agents exist and the product is built from existing channel APIs and models, so copying is quick. Cross channel learning data could build over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Comparison guides in 2026 list HubSpot Breeze, Salesforce Agentforce and other agent tools in the same space. No acquisition found.

market_need_then: Founders in YC and elsewhere lack time and expertise for growth work. The company cites customer pilots, such as a swim school software reaching 150 owners in six days, as company reported evidence.

branding.domain_note: Owns revnu.com as its primary domain.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident and punchy, with the lines GTM on autopilot and Revnu grows. They build.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear voice and a domain match, but only trade press and directories cover it and no brand discussion was found.

outcome_analysis: Revnu is active and raised a 3 million dollar seed within months of its Spring 2026 batch, led by a regional fund with YC participating. The founders ship fast and have prior bootstrapped businesses. The risk is a crowded AI growth agent market with large incumbents, so defensibility rests on cross channel learning and execution.
notes: Seed amount reported as 3M USD by BusinessCloud and Dealroom, as 2.6M EUR by others and 2.3M GBP by StartupMag, so currency conversions differ. One outlet called it Series A plus, which conflicts and is ignored. Round date taken from articles dated 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02.
